items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: I studied with a drummer who used to let me sit next to him when he was playing with an Artie Shaw type big band.

ctx.x: Did you have band experience before you went with them?

Yes. I studied with a drummer who used to let me sit next to him when he was playing with an Artie Shaw type big band. So this was great, great, a great opportunity for me. And occasionally he would take off himself. Eventually he retired I think, and I got the job. Prior to that I was working in a cinema with a little band, prior to the movies, and the drummer, starting home one night, saw one of these butterfly bombs. He walked up to it and it killed him.
